body:
the night shift: two workers from the livestock-feed study carried a sweet chemical smell. the creek smelled wrong before the siren began.

There was a place for a signature and no one willing to write one. I used the margin to note what we actually found.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached this place before they closed the road.
title: the night shift — a sweet chemical smell

body:
The man writing the names asked what I did for a living. I told him, and he put down something else.

He said the form had no space for my work. I could see there was a space; it was already filled. The person beside me told me to let him finish.

I wrote my own occupation here because I do not want the next person to think I lied about it.
title: The wrong occupation
